entries.zh: 船只倾覆、翻覆（船翻）；翻倒
entries.en: (of a ship) to capsize, be turned upside down; to overturn

entries.zh: 倾覆、翻倒（承上条船覆之义，据西语词头推断）
entries.en: to capsize, overturn (same Spanish headword; Chinese equivalent uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏「迭柔」疑为误读，音写亦未能确解，仅依同条西语词头（船倾覆）推断，故从低。

entries.zh: 满溢、外溢（水满流出）
entries.en: to overflow, run over

entries.zh: 洋溢（满而外流；今多指情绪充分流露）
entries.en: to brim over; to overflow (also, of feeling, to be exuberant)

entries.zh: 溢出来（满而漫出）
entries.en: to overflow, spill out

entries.zh: 办理、处置（事务；「辨」通「办」）
entries.en: to manage, handle, conduct (business or affairs)

entries.zh: 发（发出、发货；经商发卖）
entries.en: to send out, dispatch (goods); to deal and trade

entries.zh: 款待（好生招待；殷勤相待）
entries.en: to treat well, to entertain hospitably; also attentively, courteously

entries.zh: 对待；款待
entries.en: to treat, deal with (a person)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏残缺，仅存一个音节；据上条并词疑为「殷勤」之「殷」，无从确证，故从低。

entries.zh: 摆布（任意支配、摆弄；含好歹相待之义；汉字栏「擇布」疑为「擺布」误读）
entries.en: to order about, manipulate; to treat well or ill

entries.zh: 议亲、结亲（与对方父母谈定婚事；闽南「亲情」谓婚事）
entries.en: to negotiate a marriage with the parents; to arrange a match, betrothal

entries.zh: 怠慢（待人不周、失礼）
entries.en: to treat with neglect or discourtesy; to be remiss toward someone

entries.zh: 待他薄（刻薄相待、亏待；「伊」即他）
entries.en: to treat him ill, deal meanly with him

entries.zh: 阻滞（阻碍、迟滞；言语滞涩不畅）
entries.en: to obstruct, impede; (of speech) to falter, stall

entries.zh: 用不得其人（其人不可用、派不上用场）
entries.en: to have dealings with someone without success; the person is of no use for the purpose

entries.zh: 难为（使人为难；劳烦、亏待他人）
entries.en: to put someone to trouble; to inconvenience or embarrass

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字与音写两栏均为[空]，仅存西语条目（约「恶待、作恶」一类），无从对应释义，故存疑。

entries.zh: 背叛、叛逆（据西语疑为 Traición 类条目；汉字栏字形存疑）
entries.en: treason, treachery; a traitor (probable headword, uncertain)
entries.notes: 西语栏疑为 Traición（F 为 T 之误读），汉字栏仅存疑字形「陏/惰」，无从确证，故从低。

entries.zh: 奸恶、奸险（奸雄、奸险之徒；汉字栏「好」疑为「奸」误读）
entries.en: treachery, wickedness; a treacherous and sinister man

entries.zh: 心性奸恶（疑为「枭心」；据西语疑为「叛徒」义）
entries.en: (uncertain) a treacherous heart; a traitor
entries.notes: 西语栏疑为 Traidor 之误读，汉字「僥」疑为「梟」之误，音写无从确证，故从低。

entries.zh: 暗害（暗中谋害、陷害）
entries.en: to injure secretly, to plot against someone; secret treachery

entries.zh: 手贱（手脚不安分、爱乱动他人物件；多指顽童）
entries.en: meddlesome-handed, fidgety; mischievous (said of a boy)
